The most recent winner identified in the evidence is Ludwig Göransson, who won Best Original Score at the 2024 Oscars (96th Academy Awards) for Oppenheimer [d7]. Göransson is a two-time Oscar winner in this category, having previously won for his Black Panther score [d7]. Looking at earlier ceremonies, The Hateful Eight won the 88th Academy Award for Best Original Score, Oliver! won the 41st for Scoring of a Musical Picture, and The Lion in Winter won the 41st for Original Score (Not a Musical) [d2]. Camelot (Ken Darby & Alfred Newman) won the 40th Academy Award for Best Scoring of Music – Adaptation or Treatment [d2]. The award itself dates back to 1935, with early films such as One Night of Love (1934) and The Informer (1935) among the first associated with the category [d3][d4].
